theater: 石勒蘇益格與艾德河防線

battle.name: 第一次石勒蘇益格戰爭
battle.theater: 石勒蘇益格與艾德河防線
battle.brief: 一八四八年三月，聯邦執行軍自荷爾斯泰因南下，廿四日於倫茨堡一線與丹麥守軍相撞未果；石勒蘇益格起義軍在哈德斯萊夫奪城，七月廿五日伊斯特戰役被比隆擊敗而全軍瓦解。德國援軍與志願兵在弗里德里西亞與弗里德里希港屢攻不下，八月十四日馬爾默停戰把艾德河防線凍結，戰事拖成一八五一年。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的一方是丹麥王國：國王弗雷德里克七世同時是石勒蘇益格公爵，卻在丹麥王國的框架內推行一體化，把德語人口佔多數的石勒蘇益格併入丹麥議會是「四月憲法」的目標。丹麥的指揮體系以國王與總參謀部為核心，本土部隊為石勒蘇益格與荷爾斯泰因兩個公國的常備營，外加一八四八年臨時徵召的石勒蘇益格民軍，以及從日德蘭與西蘭調來的援軍；海軍由瓦登堡附近的分艦隊封鎖德國沿岸。另一方是日耳曼邦聯的執行軍：這支聯邦軍由普魯士、薩克森、不倫瑞克、黑森、荷爾斯泰因等邦的部隊組成，總兵力以萬計，由普魯士將領率領，目標是以武力迫使丹麥遵守一八五二年倫敦議定書、恢復荷爾斯泰因在邦聯內的舊地位。同時在場的還有石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因起義軍：這支由德語區民眾與軍官組成的武裝最初只有數千人，在伊斯特慘敗後瓦解，之後由柏林的流亡者組成「石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因兵團」重新集結。此外，瑞典與挪威依協議出兵守衛艾德河防線的西段，等於把戰線向北拉長。丹麥王國境內的德語居民多數選擇效忠丹麥王室，這一點對雙方兵力的實際分布影響很大。
countriesEn: One side was the kingdom of Denmark. King Frederik VII was also Duke of Schleswig, yet he pursued unification inside the Danish state, and folding the German-speaking majority of Schleswig into the Danish parliament was the aim of the April constitution. Danish command ran from the king and the general staff: the native troops were the standing battalions of the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein, reinforced by the Schleswig landwehr raised in 1848 and by contingents drawn from Jutland and Zealand, while a squadron of the navy blockaded the German coast. The other side was the execution corps of the German Confederation, made up of contingents from Prussia, Saxony, Brunswick, Hesse and Holstein, numbering many thousands under a Prussian commander, whose declared purpose was to force Denmark to respect the London Protocol of 1852 and to restore Holstein's old place inside the Confederation. Present as well were the Schleswig-Holstein insurgents: an armed force of German-speaking inhabitants and officers numbering only a few thousand, shattered after the defeat at Idstedt, later reconstituted in Berlin by exiles as the Schleswig-Holstein Legion. Sweden and Norway, having undertaken to hold the western stretch of the Eider line, lengthened the front northward. Most German-speaking inhabitants inside Denmark chose loyalty to the Danish crown, and that choice told heavily on how the two sides' troops were actually distributed.
people: 弗雷德里克七世是這場衝突的核心人物。他頂住了聯邦的軍事壓力，也頂住了本國激進派要求德語者自治的壓力，寧可承擔戰爭的負擔也不肯放棄石勒蘇益格公爵的頭銜。他的弟弟克里斯蒂安王子在伊斯特戰役中率領旅隊，此後在丹麥軍中一路升到元帥，後來成為克里斯蒂安九世。丹麥的戰地指揮主要是比隆將軍，他在伊斯特以兵力與火力的優勢壓垮起義軍，是丹麥在這場戰爭中唯一一場決定性勝利的主帥；恩斯特·馮·皮珀在倫茨堡堅守艾德河大橋與要塞，傷重而死，使丹麥保住了通往石勒蘇益格的門戶。起義軍方面，弗里德里希·馮·諾埃爾親王在起義瓦解後收拾殘兵，於一八四九年再起，一八五〇年隨普魯士出兵，最後流亡海外。柏林的石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因兵團由哈塞少校率領，這支部隊在弗里德里西亞的衝鋒屢屢失敗，年底又因欠餉與軍紀嘩變而被解體，兵員流散四方。普魯士方面，國王威廉四世最初打算用溫和手段解決，派去的軍隊卻在德國民族主義的浪潮裹挾下越打越深，最後在波美拉尼亞危機中幾乎與奧地利開火，只好在奧穆茨一役退讓；當年以國民警衛隊後備隊員身分參戰的俾斯麥，日後自述那幾個月的所見所聞改變了他對歐洲均勢的看法。
peopleEn: Frederik VII was the central figure in the conflict. He bore the military pressure of the Confederation and the political pressure of his own radicals, who demanded autonomy for the German speakers, and he would rather carry the burden of war than surrender the ducal crown of Schleswig. His brother Prince Christian commanded a brigade at Idstedt and rose to the rank of field marshal in the Danish army, later becoming Christian IX. The Danish command in the field belonged chiefly to General Buelow, who crushed the insurgents at Idstedt with weight of numbers and guns, the one decisive Danish success of the war; Ernst von Piper defended the Eider bridge and the works at Rendsburg and died of his wounds, which kept the gateway to Schleswig in Danish hands. On the insurgent side Prince Frederick of Noer gathered the remnants after the rising collapsed, tried again in 1849, campaigned with Prussia in 1850 and finally went into exile. The Schleswig-Holstein Legion in Berlin was led by Major von Hase; its assaults on Fredericia failed again and again, and by the end of the year it dissolved in mutiny over pay and discipline, scattering its men. In Prussia King William IV wanted the matter settled quietly, but the contingents he sent were carried deeper by the German national movement, and in the Pommern crisis the Confederation came close to a war with Austria and had to give way at Olomouc. Bismarck, who served in the Prussian landwehr in those months, afterwards said that what he saw in Schleswig had changed his view of the European balance of power.
kits: 丹麥步兵的槍械以雷管改造的火槍為主：一八四〇年代中期把舊式滑膛槍改成雷管擊發，槍管仍是滑膛，射程有限但射速與可靠性明顯優於燧發槍；海軍與沿海要塞另有少量線膛步槍。丹麥砲兵使用十二磅與二十四磅滑膛砲，在要塞與城鎮的攻防中數量不多但部署集中。聯邦執行軍的核心武器是一八四一年制式的普魯士針式雷管步槍，擊錘擊發底火、槍管有膛線，配紙殼藥包使用，是歐洲最早成規模列裝的針式步槍之一；薩克森與不倫瑞克等邦多沿用各自的舊式火槍。起義軍的武裝最為駁雜：石勒蘇益格民軍多數持獵槍與舊式燧發槍，數量有限，紙殼彈與火藥更是稀缺，常常一天只能打上幾槍；柏林的石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因兵團則從德國各邦取得較新的雷管步槍，卻缺少訓練與後勤。攻城器材方面，聯邦軍攜帶可拆分的攻城砲與輕野砲，起義軍只能就地砍伐木材築成胸牆。運輸上，聯邦軍可利用一八四四年通車的阿爾托納-基爾鐵路把人馬送到荷爾斯泰因各點，丹麥則靠日德蘭的公路與新建的羅克維爾-內斯特韋德鐵路調動。
kitsEn: The Danish infantry was armed mainly with muskets converted to percussion: the older smoothbores of the 1840s were turned to cap ignition, the barrel still without rifling, so that range was limited but rate of fire and reliability were clearly better than with flint. The navy and the coastal works had a few rifled muskets as well. Danish artillery used twelve- and twenty-four-pound smoothbores, few in number but tightly grouped in the defence of fortresses and towns. The core weapon of the federal execution corps was the Prussian Model 1841 Zundnadelgewehr, a needle-fired percussion rifle with a rifled barrel and a complete paper cartridge, one of the first such weapons to be issued in numbers in Europe; Saxony and Brunswick, for their part, kept their older flintlocks. The insurgents had the most heterogeneous equipment of all. The Schleswig landwehr carried mostly sporting guns and old flintlocks in limited numbers, and paper cartridges and powder were so scarce that many men fired a few shots a day; the Schleswig-Holstein Legion in Berlin obtained newer percussion rifles from the German states, but lacked training and supply. In the way of siege equipment the federal corps brought up demountable siege guns and light field pieces, while the insurgents could only fell timber on the spot and build breastworks. In transport, the federal troops used the Altona-Kiel railway, opened in 1844, to move men and horses to their points in Holstein, and Denmark shifted its troops by road across Jutland and by the newly opened Roskilde-Naestved railway.
tactics: 戰線沿艾德河與其支流展開。丹麥放棄荷爾斯泰因，把主力縮到石勒蘇益格一側，利用艾德河作為天然屏障，在倫茨堡的橋頭與兩岸築壘固守。聯邦執行軍的戰術是先以騎兵偵察、砲兵隔河支援，再由工兵架橋或強行涉水，但荷爾斯泰因境內到處是泥濘與堤壩，火力難以展開，試圖強渡的部隊在倫茨堡一線受挫。起義軍利用鄉村地形作游擊：夜間襲擊守軍的哨位與軍械庫，白天退回樹林與村落，令丹麥的正規步兵屢遭撲空。比隆的解法是把戰鬥拉到他選定的地面：伊斯特一役，起義軍占據一片高地與籬笆線，丹麥步兵以縱隊進攻，在起伏地形裡屢次被切斷，砲火只能在有限視野內發揮，起義軍的陣線因此瓦解。海上的封鎖是另一條戰線：丹麥分艦隊封鎖德國北岸，轟擊弗里德里希港的海岸砲台與船塢，切斷起義軍的補給；八月馬爾默停戰之後，這條封鎖線依然維持到一八五〇年。總體而言，聯邦軍靠的是制式化軍隊與後勤，起義軍靠的是群眾動員與地形，兩種打法在同一片沼澤與田園地帶正面相撞，結局在伊斯特一役已經決定。
tacticsEn: The front ran along the Eider and its tributaries. Denmark gave up Holstein, drew its main body back to the Schleswig side, used the river as a natural barrier and fortified the bridgehead at Rendsburg and both banks. The federal execution corps rode ahead with cavalry, supported its guns across the river and let engineers bridge or ford, but Holstein was a country of mud and dykes in which artillery could hardly deploy, and the attempts to force the river broke against Rendsburg. The insurgents used the country for partisan work, striking at night at outposts and depots and falling back into the woods and villages by day, so that the Danish regulars kept missing them. Buelow's answer was to bring the fight onto ground of his choosing: at Idstedt the insurgents held a rise and a line of hedges, the Danish infantry advanced in columns and was cut apart again and again over broken ground, the guns could see only a part of the field, and the insurgent line came apart. At sea there was a second front: the Danish squadron blockaded the German coast and bombarded the coastal battery and dockyard at Friedrichsort, cutting the insurgents off from supply, and after the armistice of Malmoe that blockade was kept up until 1850. In the end the federal army relied on regular troops and logistics while the insurgents relied on mass mobilisation and terrain, and the two systems collided on the same marshes and farmland; the result was decided at Idstedt.
data: 數字方面可確定的部分有限。聯邦執行軍第一批入境的部隊約一萬人，其後各邦增援，總數接近兩萬，但實際能投入作戰的兵力因為補給與紀律問題而低於名冊。起義軍的核心武裝是一八四八年徵召的石勒蘇益格民軍，約三千至四千人；柏林的石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因兵團另有三千上下。伊斯特一役，丹麥方面出動約四千人並有十門左右的野砲，起義軍約三千五百人；丹麥公報宣稱俘虛以千計，實際陣亡數各方說法相差頗大，起義軍在這一役後可說全軍覆沒。弗里德里西亞一帶的數次攻勢，起義軍與兵團屢攻不下，傷亡數百。海上方面，一八四八年八月廿三日蒸汽巡防艦辛布里亞號在倫茨堡外海擱淺沉沒，艦員大部獲救；丹麥封鎖德國北岸期間扣押的商船數以百計。時間跨度是這場戰爭的特點：從一八四八年三月打到一八五一年，前後三年，期間穿插一八四九年至一八五〇年的第三次石勒蘇益格戰爭與波美拉尼亞危機。
dataEn: Few of the numbers for this war can be established. The first federal contingents entering Holstein were about ten thousand men, and reinforcements from the member states brought the total to nearly twenty thousand, though the strength actually fit for action was below paper strength because of supply and discipline. The core insurgent force was the Schleswig landwehr raised in 1848, some three to four thousand men; the Schleswig-Holstein Legion in Berlin numbered about three thousand more. At Idstedt Denmark engaged roughly four thousand men with some ten field guns against about three thousand five hundred insurgents; the Danish reports claimed a thousand prisoners, and the actual number of dead differs from account to account, but the insurgents were for practical purposes destroyed. The repeated attempts on Fredericia by the insurgents and the Legion achieved nothing and cost hundreds of men. At sea, the steam sloop Cimbria ran aground and was lost off Rendsburg on 23 August 1848, most of her crew being saved; during the blockade of the German coast Denmark detained merchantmen in the hundreds. The duration is the striking feature of this war: from March 1848 to 1851, three years, interrupted by the Third Schleswig War of 1849 and 1850 and by the crisis over Pommern.
cause: 這場戰爭是「石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因問題」的一次軍事化。一八四四年丹麥王室的「阿爾托納之夜」血腥事件已讓德語區的學生與知識界把丹麥視為壓迫者；一八四六年丹麥召集石勒蘇益格制憲會議，會上德語議員被排斥，議會被驅散，幾位代表投水自盡，引發日耳曼各邦的強烈反應。丹麥國王則希望藉「四月憲法」把石勒蘇益格正式併入丹麥議會，荷爾斯泰因另設議會，並以此回應一八四八年二月巴黎革命所帶來的自由主義壓力。從日耳曼邦聯的立場看，荷爾斯泰因是邦聯成員，石勒蘇益格只是丹麥的封地，聯邦有權執行一八五二年倫敦議定書，維護荷爾斯泰因的舊制度，並阻止石勒蘇益格被吸收。一八四八年三月德國的革命浪潮讓聯邦得以迅速出兵；但真正的爆點是起義軍的存在：德語區民眾與軍官自行武裝，把一場邦際法律爭議變成國與國之間的公開戰爭，聯邦軍隊反而要與起義軍站在同一條線上，政策上十分為難。丹麥則藉此把「艾德河為界」的說法推到國際桌面上，之後半個世紀的歐洲外交都圍繞這條河的三寸水展開。
causeEn: This war was the militarisation of the Schleswig-Holstein question. The bloody Altona night of 1844 had already made the students and intellectuals of the German-speaking territories see Denmark as an oppressor, and when Denmark convened a constituent assembly for Schleswig in 1846, excluded the German deputies, drove the assembly out and saw several deputies drown themselves, the reaction in the German states was violent. The Danish king, for his part, wanted the April constitution to fold Schleswig formally into the Danish parliament with a separate parliament for Holstein, and thereby to answer the liberal pressure that followed the February revolution in Paris. From the point of view of the German Confederation, Holstein was a member of the Confederation and Schleswig only a Danish fief, so the Confederation was entitled to enforce the London Protocol of 1852, to uphold the old arrangements in Holstein and to prevent Schleswig from being absorbed. The German revolutionary wave of March 1848 allowed the Confederation to send troops quickly; but the real flashpoint was the existence of the insurgents. German-speaking inhabitants and officers armed themselves, turning a legal dispute between states into an open war between two countries, and the federal troops found themselves required to stand on the same line as the insurgents, which was politically impossible. Denmark used the war to put the claim of the Eider line on the international table, and European diplomacy would circle around that river for half a century afterwards.
impact: 戰爭沒有解決問題，卻重新定義了問題。丹麥保住了石勒蘇益格的主權，卻在艾德河問題上被推上國際輿論的被告席，日耳曼民族主義從此把「收復石勒蘇益格」寫進政治綱領，一八六四年的第二次石勒蘇益格戰爭因此在丹麥看來是史無前例的侵略。丹麥內部，新憲法雖在一八四九年十一月公佈，卻以「國家統一而不可分」的公式維持了丹麥對石勒蘇益格的兼併，日德之間的裂痕反而加深。普魯士的失敗也教會了德國人兩件事：聯邦國家的軍隊不足以單獨承擔丹麥這樣的對手，民族主義的政治訴求必須與國家力量綁在一起才能落實；一八四九年的波美拉尼亞危機更讓聯邦內部看清奧地利與普魯士之間的裂痕，普魯士被迫在奧穆茨退讓，此後十年間只能以「小德意志方案」為最終目標。軍事技術上，這是針式雷管步槍第一次在歐洲戰場上成規模使用，槍械供應、鐵路輸送與海岸封鎖的配合方式，也為後來的普丹戰爭提供了經驗。
impactEn: The war settled nothing, but it redefined the question. Denmark kept its sovereignty over Schleswig and was placed in the dock of European opinion on the Eider; German nationalism wrote the recovery of Schleswig into its programme, which is why the war of 1864 looked to Denmark like an act of aggression without precedent. Inside Denmark the new constitution of November 1849 maintained the union of Schleswig to Denmark under the formula that the state was one and indivisible, and the rift between the two peoples grew rather than healed. Prussian failure taught the Germans two things as well: the army of a confederation was not strong enough to face Denmark alone, and a national political claim had to be welded to state power before it could be enforced. The crisis over Pommern in 1849 also laid bare the split between Austria and Prussia inside the Confederation, and after the retreat at Olomouc Prussia was left for the next decade with the small German solution as its only goal. In military terms this was the first large-scale European employment of the needle percussion rifle, and the combination of weapons supply, railway movement and coastal blockade practised here was a rehearsal for the later Danish war of 1864.
result: 聯邦執行軍沒能把丹麥逐回艾德河以北，一八四八年八月十四日簽訂的馬爾默停戰線凍結了戰線，瑞典與挪威軍隊接管西段防務，聯邦軍在北部幾座要塞前無法推進。起義軍在伊斯特慘敗後瓦解，石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因兵團在弗里德里西亞的失敗與年底的嘩變中被解散，弗里德里希·馮·諾埃爾親王流亡海外，柏林的流亡組織轉入地下。戰爭延續到一八四九年至一八五〇年的第三次石勒蘇益格戰爭，普魯士在英國與俄國的調停下被迫在奧穆茨放棄對荷爾斯泰因的支持，一八五〇年倫敦議定書維持現狀，一八五一年丹麥以新憲法確認石勒蘇益格與丹麥的統一，荷爾斯泰因的舊邦聯地位同時被取消。第一次石勒蘇益格戰爭的結局因此是維持原狀：沒有一方得到想要的答案，但那條艾德河線從此成為歐洲最敏感的一條線，直到一八六四年被普魯士與奧地利聯軍越過。
resultEn: The federal execution corps did not drive Denmark back north of the Eider. The armistice of Malmoe of 14 August 1848 froze the front, Swedish and Norwegian troops took over the western stretch of the line, and the federal army made no progress against the northern fortresses. The insurgents dissolved after the defeat at Idstedt, the Schleswig-Holstein Legion was disbanded after its failures at Fredericia and its mutiny at the year's end, Prince Frederick of Noer went into exile, and the Berlin exiles went underground. The war ran on into the Third Schleswig War of 1849 and 1850, where Prussia, under British and Russian mediation, had to abandon its support for Holstein at Olomouc; the London Protocol of 1850 confirmed the status quo, and in 1851 Denmark fixed the union of Schleswig and Denmark in a new constitution while the old position of Holstein inside the Confederation was abolished. The outcome of the First Schleswig War was therefore a maintained status quo. Neither side got the answer it wanted, but the line on the Eider became the most sensitive line in Europe until it was crossed by the armies of Prussia and Austria in 1864.
